thread:
Isabel: Quick ping — final onsite for candidate Taylor is scheduled for Wed. Need: panel confirmation, debrief lead, and a quick rubric clarification. Slots I proposed: 10:00-11:30 PT or 13:00-14:30 PT. Can people confirm availability?
Ben: 10:00 works for me. happy to interview.
Priya: I can do either but prefer 10am if possible.
Sam: I’m booked 10-11 but free for 13:00. If we move, I can take the system-design slot.
Isabel: Okay noted. If Sam takes 13:00 then 10:00 still needs one more interviewer (algorithms). @Ben can you cover algos at 10?
Ben: Yep I can cover algos at 10. :thumbsup:
Elena: Heads up — candidate is in MST. 10:00 PT = 11:00 MST. Confirming they’re OK with that.
Isabel: Good catch. I already double-checked; they confirmed 10am PT.
Priya: Quick rubric Q: do we use 1-5 for each dimension and sum, or mark pass/fail per dimension? Don’t want inconsistent scoring across panel.
Ben: We normally do 1-5 per dimension and highlight a blocker flag if any dimension <=2. Recommend we call out "problem solving" and "communication" as weighted.
Isabel: Proposal: use 1-5 scale and add a single blocker toggle. Here’s a tiny template — please use during debrief:```
Problem solving: 1-5
Communication: 1-5
Ownership & Product sense: 1-5
Blocker: yes/no + short note
Overall hire: yes/maybe/no
```
Priya: That helps. Should we emphasize design tradeoffs more for this role?
Sam: Yes, emphasize tradeoffs + constraints (latency/cost) for the system-design round. I’ll ask targeted follow-ups.
Isabel: Also need a debrief lead to synthesize notes 15m after session. Who can own?
Sam: I can own debrief if we run at 13:00.
Ben: If we keep 10:00 I can do synthesis + send notes.
Isabel: Great — sounds like two options. I’ll move forward with 10:00 if no objections since majority prefers.
Priya: No objections from me.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Taylor — Final onsite" Wed 10:00-11:30 PT. Attendees: Isabel, Ben, Priya, Elena.
Isabel: Linking eval doc for post-interview notes: https://docs.internal/recruiting/evals/taylor-final — please paste score snapshot there immediately after debrief.
Ben: Will do.
Priya: One more tiny ask — please mark interviewers' roles in the doc (algos / system / culture) so hiring manager can parse quickly.
Isabel: Done. I annotated roles in the calendar and the doc. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
